mechanism: Insulin promotes intracellular potassium uptake by activating Na-K-ATPase, potentially causing hypokalemia and increasing risk of hypokalemia-related cardiac arrhythmias when potassium supplementation is inadequate.
action: Monitor serum potassium levels regularly during insulin therapy, especially with high doses or rapid-acting formulations; coordinate potassium supplementation with insulin dosing and adjust based on laboratory values.
